name: AIConfidenceRiskBadge
description: A labelled confidence level with an optional risk level, plus stale-data and missing-source indicators. The bar is decorative; the text is the value.
intent: State how sure the model is and how much is at stake, before the human decides.

props.name: confidence
props.hint: Required. Declared in the component source.

props.name: risk
props.hint: Optional. Declared in the component source.

props.name: staleData
props.hint: Optional. Declared in the component source.

props.name: missingSource
props.hint: Optional. Declared in the component source.

props.name: compact
props.hint: Optional. Declared in the component source.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

notes: The bar is aria-hidden. Every level has a text label, so confidence is never colour-only.
The three confidence colours are green, amber and red — do not rely on them alone for users who cannot distinguish them. The labels are the contract.

usage: Beside any AI output a human will act on
In an approval flow, before ai:ai-action
Wherever the cost of the model being wrong is non-trivial
doNotUse: When the model did not produce a confidence value — omit it rather than inventing one
On trivial output where the badge is noise
As a generic status badge — use ui:badge
Use as a generic status badge

agentRules: Never render a confidence value the model did not produce. Absent means absent, not high.
Never map a model probability onto a level without documenting the thresholds.
Show it before the decision, not after.
missingSource is a claim about the output, not a UI state — only set it when true.
